conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The Envoy is not sold by Ergo Glast. His Holokey stock cannot provide it.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: charged Requiem mods
rows.alt: trade duplicates or buy cheap mods from players

conditions: Sisters use Requiem mods, not Hex mods. The eight regular mods are Fass, Jahu, Khra, Lohk, Netra, Ris, Vome, and Xata.
Each successful vanquish consumes one charge from every equipped Requiem mod. Bring a usable pool before spawning the Sister.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and reduces the risk of a bad early sequence guess.

groups.activity: clear Granum Void; inspect Sister Candidates

rows.label: Tenet Envoy Candidate
rows.note: Mercy only when weapon preview says Envoy
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Envoy Sister

rows.label: Toxin progenitor
rows.note: combines with innate Cold for Viral

conditions: Kill a Treasurer on a Corpus ship node to obtain Zenith Granum Crowns. Fissures and Syndicate missions cannot spawn a Candidate.
At the Golden Hand, spend the crown and kill 25 enemies in the Granum Void while solo. Finish the mission; the Candidate appears after exiting the Void.
The downed Candidate previews its weapon. If it is not Envoy, do not Mercy it: complete and extract to remove that weapon from the pool. Aborting does not cycle the pool.
The Warframe that performs the Mercy fixes the progenitor element. The Envoy has innate Cold, so Toxin produces Viral without a mod slot.
bonuses: Xoris makes fast, consistent Granum Void clears. Specters and On-Call crew can also enter the Void.

disclosures.title: the crown is the real reroll cost
disclosures.body: Each rejected Candidate still consumes a Zenith Granum Crown. Complete bad Hydra runs rather than aborting: every completed rejection narrows the eleven-weapon Sister pool until Envoy is forced.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal Requiems, and test the sequence
conditions: Mercy Sister Hounds before downing the Sister; Hounds self-destruct when she falls and then award no Murmurs.
Murmur reveals average about 36, 60, and 84 progress. Failed Parazon attempts reveal sequence order but rank up and relocate the Sister.
Do not Mercy blindly before any mods are known unless deliberately using Oull; a higher-rank Sister is tougher and appears less often after her rage resets.
bonuses: Public squads accelerate Murmurs; an Oull slot allows a safe wildcard guess.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion grants a tradeable Sister contract, not the weapon.
The Envoy arrives built in the Foundry at its rolled bonus percentage; no crafting materials or timer are needed.
bonuses: A vanquish can award Oull, useful for the next Sister.

disclosures.title: do not let the choice time out
disclosures.body: The Convert or Vanquish screen has a short timer. Convert is not a way to claim the Envoy; it permanently trades the weapon for a Sister ally/contract.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 × the higher bonus, 60%), rounded down to one decimal; any result of at least 58% becomes 60%.
Fuse into the invested Envoy. The donor is destroyed along with its Forma, Catalyst, adapters, and lens; choose which progenitor element survives.
Elemental Vice changes only the bonus element after rank 40 with five Forma. It never changes the percentage.
bonuses: Since the current roll is randomized across the 25-60% band, a 52.8% Envoy reaches 60% in one fusion.
